additional_info.subject: 0475563 - ID0475563-DC/Si-D/FR- [MP / P9 170000856] Charging Issue CRM:03208000162
additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0475563
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue. We kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
MP / P9 170000856
Charger ID / Serial No.:
B0JHOi
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Handover reason:
​​​​​
Please proceed with the following troubleshooting:
If FB1 tripped, it means current was finding an unintended path to earth.
If FC5 tripped, it means too much current was flowing - doesn't seem like it.
​​​​Visual Inspection:
Charging Cable: Carefully inspect the entire length of the charging cable for any signs of damage: cuts, kinks, crushing, discoloration, or exposed wires. Check the connectors at both ends.
EV Charging Port: Look inside the EVs charging port for any debris, moisture, or damage to the pins.
Charger: Check for any visible damage, signs of overheating, or moisture.
Isolate and Test (If Possible & Safe):
If you have access to another charging cable, try using that (ensuring it's safe to do so).
From the logs I cannot see which component tripped. Please take spare FB1 and FC5 if need to replace anything.
Please also check the F06-BC5 AC meter & ethernet connection to the F11-XF2 switch and PLC ethernet connections to the switch.
Also please carry a spare tested ethernet cable.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-FR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Technical Support Team –
Harun Ar Rashid
Please do not change the subject line when replying to this email.
Mit Freundlichen Grüßen/ Melhores Cumprimentos/ Best Regards
Harun Ar Rashid
Technical Support Specialist (eMobility)
Av. 25 de Abril 201, 2845-547, Corroios, Portugal.
